newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Montenegro's port Bar, Italy's Adriatico sign deal.
newsitem.headline: Montenegro's port Bar, Italy's Adriatico sign deal.

text.p: Montenegro's port Luka Bar and Italy's Venice-based state shipping company Adriatico signed an agreement on Tuesday on setting up a regular service line via the Bar port.
The agreement was signed for a five-year period, the port said in a press release faxed to Reuters.
The service comprises a regular twice-weekly ferry line Bar-Bari-Bar and a weekly ferry line to the Italian port of Ancona. The first ship will arrive on June 12 from Ancona.
A new cargo line Bar-Ancona will be opened in two to three weeks, the release said.
Mercur and Co., a joint stock Italian-Montenegrin company, will be Adriatico's official agent. -- Beti Bilandzic, Belgrade newsroom +381 11 222 4305
